title: 互质树
summary: 对树中每个节点，找其祖先中与节点值互质且距离最近者的下标，不存在返回负一。
insight: 节点值仅 1..50。DFS 路径上为每个值维护最近节点及深度，进入节点时枚举 50 个值找互质且深度最大的候选，递归子树后恢复路径状态。
pitfalls: 同值路径状态需用栈以便回溯恢复
最近祖先对应最大深度

solutions.title: 值域祖先栈 DFS
solutions.idea: 利用小值域快速查询当前根到节点路径上的最近互质值。
steps: 建树，stacks[51] 保存 [node,depth] 路径记录
DFS node 时枚举 value=1..50，gcd(nums[node],value)==1 且栈非空时取深度最大者
写答案后压入本节点，递归孩子，再弹出

code.java: class Solution { private int[] nums,answer;private List<Integer>[] graph;private Deque<int[]>[] stacks;private int gcd(int a,int b){return b==0?a:gcd(b,a%b);}private void dfs(int node,int parent,int depth){int bestDepth=-1;for(int value=1;value<=50;value++)if(gcd(nums[node],value)==1&&!stacks[value].isEmpty()&&stacks[value].peekLast()[1]>bestDepth){bestDepth=stacks[value].peekLast()[1];answer[node]=stacks[value].peekLast()[0];}stacks[nums[node]].offerLast(new int[]{node,depth});for(int next:graph[node])if(next!=parent)dfs(next,node,depth+1);stacks[nums[node]].pollLast();}public int[] getCoprimes(int[] nums,int[][] edges){this.nums=nums;answer=new int[nums.length];Arrays.fill(answer,-1);graph=new List[nums.length];stacks=new Deque[51];for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=1;i<=50;i++)stacks[i]=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int[] edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0]);}dfs(0,-1,0);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var nums:IntArray;private lateinit var answer:IntArray;private lateinit var graph:Array<MutableList<Int>>;private lateinit var stacks:Array<java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>>;private fun gcd(a:Int,b:Int):Int=if(b==0)a else gcd(b,a%b);private fun dfs(node:Int,parent:Int,depth:Int){var bestDepth=-1;for(value in 1..50)if(gcd(nums[node],value)==1&&stacks[value].isNotEmpty()&&stacks[value].last[1]>bestDepth){bestDepth=stacks[value].last[1];answer[node]=stacks[value].last[0]};stacks[nums[node]].addLast(intArrayOf(node,depth));for(next in graph[node])if(next!=parent)dfs(next,node,depth+1);stacks[nums[node]].removeLast()};fun getCoprimes(nums:IntArray,edges:Array<IntArray>):IntArray{this.nums=nums;answer=IntArray(nums.size){-1};graph=Array(nums.size){mutableListOf()};stacks=Array(51){java.util.ArrayDeque()};for(edge in edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0])};dfs(0,-1,0);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> nums,answer;vector<vector<int>> graph;vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> stacks;int gcdValue(int a,int b){return b?gcdValue(b,a%b):a;}void dfs(int node,int parent,int depth){int bestDepth=-1;for(int value=1;value<=50;++value)if(gcdValue(nums[node],value)==1&&!stacks[value].empty()&&stacks[value].back().second>bestDepth){bestDepth=stacks[value].back().second;answer[node]=stacks[value].back().first;}stacks[nums[node]].push_back({node,depth});for(int next:graph[node])if(next!=parent)dfs(next,node,depth+1);stacks[nums[node]].pop_back();}public:vector<int> getCoprimes(vector<int>& input,vector<vector<int>>& edges){nums=input;answer.assign(nums.size(),-1);graph.assign(nums.size(),{});stacks.assign(51,{});for(auto& edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].push_back(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].push_back(edge[0]);}dfs(0,-1,0);return answer;} };
